source: EN 1997-1 (recommended values; the design approach is a National choice, see VERIFY.md)

sources.designApproach: EN 1997-1 2.4.7.3.4.1 (the approach is a National choice; DA1 here is SAEngine practice, overridable)
sources.actions: EN 1997-1 Annex A Table A.3 (sets A1, A2)
sources.materials: EN 1997-1 Annex A Table A.4 (sets M1, M2)
sources.spreadResistances: EN 1997-1 Annex A Table A.5 (spread foundations), Table A.13 (earth resistance of retaining structures)
sources.pileResistances: EN 1997-1 Annex A Tables A.6 (driven), A.7 (bored), A.8 (CFA)
sources.approaches: EN 1997-1 2.4.7.3.4.2-2.4.7.3.4.4 (DA1 combinations 1 and 2, piles A2 + M1 + R4; DA2; DA3 with A1 on structural and A2 on geotechnical actions)
sources.bearing: EN 1997-1 Annex D.3 (undrained), D.4 (drained): Nγ = 2 (Nq - 1) tan φ', sγ = 1 - 0.3 B'/L', sc = 1 + 0.2 B'/L'
sources.sliding: EN 1997-1 6.5.3(8)-(12): δd = φ'cv,d cast in place, 2/3 φ'cv,d smooth precast; Rd <= 0.4 Vd undrained where water or air can reach the interface
sources.correlation: EN 1997-1 Annex A Tables A.9 (static load tests ξ1, ξ2), A.10 (ground tests ξ3, ξ4); 7.6.2.2(9), 7.6.2.3(9): ÷ 1.1 for structures stiff and strong enough
sources.footings: SAEngine practice: the founding layer's characteristic φ', c', cu, γ of the nearest borehole; drained where it gives φ', undrained where it gives cu (both where both); cast in place; water may reach the base; φ'cv,k = φ'k where none is given (EN 1997-1 6.5.3(10) takes φ'cv,d); overridable
sources.equilibrium: EN 1990 Annex A1 Table A1.2(A) (EQU, recommended: γG,dst 1.10, γG,stb 0.90, γQ 1.50); EN 1997-1 2.4.7.2 and Table A.1
sources.retaining: EN 1997-1 9.5 (earth pressures: Ka with the design φ'd of the combination's M set, Annex C), 9.7.2-9.7.3 (bearing and sliding by 6.5.2, 6.5.3 on the effective base width B' = B - 2e), 9.7.4 and 2.4.7.2 (overturning as EQU: the design destabilising moment at most the stabilising one); EN 1992-1-1 for the stem and base
